trends.title: Packaged CDPs are leaning into AI agents for marketers
trends.detail: Three of six tracked competitors shipped or repositioned around AI for marketers in three weeks. Expect 'AI-ready' to replace 'unified profile' as the headline claim in Q4 evaluations.

trends.title: Suites are closing the warehouse gap on paper
trends.detail: Zero-copy connectors and warehouse-linked audiences let suites say 'we work with your warehouse.' The fight moves from 'do you connect' to 'what runs on it directly.'

trends.title: Bundling is the real threat in enterprise
trends.detail: Losses to suite vendors cluster around renewals and features moving into base editions. This is a procurement problem as much as a product one.

winLossQuestions.question: When the existing Salesforce or Adobe contract came up, at what stage did it enter the conversation, and who raised it?
winLossQuestions.gap: We don't know whether we lose bundled deals early (never really in) or late (lost at procurement).

winLossQuestions.question: Did your marketers try building audiences in Segment's new builder during the evaluation? What did they hit?
winLossQuestions.gap: No hands-on evidence yet on how Signal #14 performs in real evaluations.

winLossQuestions.question: How much did 'AI decisioning' weigh in the final decision compared with activation and data governance?
winLossQuestions.gap: We can't yet tell if AI is a deciding factor or a tie-breaker.
